assessments.support: Full 17-site ABIDE-I used (Table 1 gives per-site N), with only a 'missing information' exclusion rule stated, no further clinical/demographic inclusion criteria detailed.
C-PAC pipeline and AAL (90-region) atlas named; connectivity-matrix feature construction clearly described.
ASD/control diagnosis labels taken as distributed by ABIDE; diagnostic instrument not restated in this paper.

The Teacher/Student feature-ranking network and SFFS feature selection are both fit on the full dataset before the reported 10-fold cross-validation of the final classifier; the text does not describe the Teacher/Student training or feature selection being repeated within each CV fold, indicating a likely feature-selection leakage risk. All 17 sites are pooled for the headline accuracy with no leave-site-out evaluation or site covariate.

risk_of_bias.summary: A large, full-ABIDE-I (17-site) classification study with named pipeline/atlas, but feature-selection (Teacher-Student + SFFS) appears to be performed prior to the reported cross-validation rather than nested within folds, and no leave-site-out or site-harmonisation evaluation is reported despite pooling all 17 sites.

charting.title: A Three-Stage Teacher, Student Neural Networks and Sequential Feed Forward Selection-Based Feature Selection Approach for the Classification of Autism Spectrum Disorder
charting.dataset_openly_available: Uses the publicly available preprocessed ABIDE dataset; no study-specific code/participant-list repository link found in the text
charting.specific_features: 90x90 Pearson correlation functional connectivity matrix (AAL atlas, 90 regions), upper-triangular feature vector (4005 features), reduced via a Teacher-Student deep-learning feature-ranking method and Sequential Forward Feature Selection (SFFS)
charting.feature_extraction_tools: C-PAC pipeline; AAL atlas (90 regions); custom Teacher-Student neural network + SFFS feature-selection pipeline
charting.importance_method: Student-network hidden-layer weight magnitude ranking, refined by SFFS
charting.top_features_identified: A set of 154 top-ranked connectivity features reported as common across classifiers (visualized via BrainNet-viewer connectogram)
charting.specific_algorithms: Teacher Neural Network, Student autoencoder, SFFS; final classifiers: Logistic Regression, Linear Discriminant, SVM, Random Forest, Decision Tree
charting.key_performance_results: Maximum 10-fold accuracy on combined 17-site dataset: 82% (Logistic Regression and Linear Discriminant classifiers, sensitivity 0.83, specificity 0.84-0.88); outperformed prior published methods (e.g. Heinsfeld et al. 2018: 63%; Taban Eslami et al. 2019: 67%) in the same comparison table; outperformed state-of-the-art in 13 of 17 individual sites using 5-fold CV
charting.summary_key_findings: On the full preprocessed ABIDE-I dataset (17 sites, 505 ASD/530 controls after removing subjects with missing information), a novel 3-stage Teacher-Student-and-SFFS feature selection approach on 90x90 AAL-atlas connectivity matrices achieved a maximum 10-fold cross-validated accuracy of 82% on the combined dataset (Logistic Regression/Linear Discriminant classifiers) and outperformed prior state-of-the-art methods in 13 of 17 individual sites.
charting.reviewer_notes: Feature-ranking (Teacher-Student) and feature-selection (SFFS) steps appear to precede the reported cross-validation rather than being nested within folds, a potential leakage concern not explicitly addressed in the text read.

narrative_row.study_design_sample_dataset: Diagnostic prediction; ABIDE-I, all 17 sites; n=505 ASD / 530 controls (N=1035) after removing subjects with missing information.
narrative_row.methods: C-PAC-preprocessed data; AAL atlas (90 regions, 90x90 FC matrix); novel Teacher-Student deep-learning feature ranking plus Sequential Forward Feature Selection (SFFS); classifiers (LR, LD, SVM, RF, DT) evaluated with 10-fold (combined) and 5-fold (site-wise) cross-validation.
narrative_row.outcomes: Maximum 82% 10-fold accuracy on the combined 17-site dataset (LR/LD), outperforming prior published ABIDE classifiers in the same comparison table, and outperforming state-of-the-art in 13/17 individual sites.
narrative_row.key_limitations: Feature selection (Teacher-Student + SFFS) appears performed prior to, rather than nested within, the reported cross-validation folds (potential leakage); all 17 sites pooled with explicitly ignored site variability and no leave-site-out evaluation; no motion/QC threshold or code/data release reported.
narrative_row.relevance_notes: A full-ABIDE-I (17-site) classification benchmark illustrating a novel feature-selection method, useful for the knowledge graph's predictive-methods comparisons but with notable risk-of-bias caveats around leakage and site pooling.
